historia.titulo: Camisa do Red Sox em Fenway
historia.texto: Na segunda noite em Fenway, o Eddie brindou à equipe que cuidou do gramado no dia de folga. Em Even Flow, o Mike solou montado na grade, colado na primeira fila. O Tom Hamilton, do Aerosmith, subiu pra Draw the Line tocando o baixo de 12 cordas xadrez do Jeff. O Kevin Youkilis voltou ao palco e disse que ali só se tocava de camisa do Red Sox: o Eddie levou a mão ao cinto, mas ficou de calça e vestiu a camisa. Mais tarde lembrou que o primeiro hotel da banda ali era um Howard Johnson do outro lado da rua: levaram 25 anos pra atravessar. Falou do atentado da Maratona e contou que estavam no estúdio escrevendo Yellow Moon naquele dia. No fim, o J Mascis entrou em Rockin' in the Free World, com o Mike no baixo.
historia.rotuloFonte: Fanviews do fórum oficial do Pearl Jam

fontes.trecho: EV goes on to enumerates all of the hard work the grounds crew had to put in on the off day to keep these hallowed grounds looking good.  He toasts the great ground crew and all the work they do.
Even Flow (Mike straddles the barricade and solos a bit with the front row.)
Draw The Line-(Perry, Tyler) W/ Tom Hamilton of Aerosmith.  Tom plays Jeff’s checkerboard 12 string bass.

once again Kevin Youkilis comes out.  He tells Ed that the only way to play Fenway is if you wear a Red Sox Jersey.  Ed reaches for his belt and begins to unbuckle it asking “just a Red Sox Jersey?”  Ed ends up keeping his pants on but he does wear the jersey
It was a Howard Johnson’s that was across the street.  The band jokes that it took them 25 years to just get across the street
Ed brings up the Boston Marathon bombing tragedy.

They were in the studio when it happened and this was the song they were writing that day and some events influenced the lyrics.)

22. Yellow Moon
Rockin’ In The Free World-(Young) w/ J Mascis.  Mike McCready on bass

Show #14 da série: Fenway Park, Boston, 7 de agosto de 2016. Teve Tom Hamilton, do Aerosmith, no baixo do Jeff, o Eddie de camisa do Red Sox e J Mascis em Rockin' in the Free World. Arrasta pro lado pra ler a história e ver o setlist inteiro. Qual estádio de beisebol você queria ver o Pearl Jam tocar?
